facility.name: Red Apple Private School & Childcare
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 7605 BISSONNET ST, HOUSTON, TX, 77074

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: The van used for transporting children did not have Parent names and telephone numbers and emergency telephone numbers for eleven children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Corrections Made to Annual Sanitation Inspection: A staff member used the kitchen stove, which was previously cited by the local health department as unapproved and required to be removed. The operation informed the health department that the stove was not in use; however, it was observed being used to cook food for children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Corrections Made to Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3405)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The last sanitation inspection was completed 02/12/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The van used for transporting children did not have emergency medical transport and treatment authorization information for eleven children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The pre-k and school-age caregivers were observed left their groups unsupervised, According to one caregiver, The prek teacher supervised both groups while the school-age careigver escorted a group of toddlers to another room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Janitorial duties: A caregiver was observed cleaning their room, while children were playing and running around the room, according the the caregiver they were cleaning after a meal.    Note: There was no food observed on the floor or tables. There was cleaning spray on the handwashing sink in reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Janitorial duties (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(C))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: The operation did not have a posted list for a child with a diagnosed food allergy
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In one room, a vent covering was observed to be missing, another room, the vent covering was observed to be falling down. A light switch was observed to be missing a plate cover.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have a plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - No Overlap: A little tikes climing structure was observed to be overlaping the use zone of other climbing structures on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - No Overlap (26 TAC §746.4805(d))

occurrences.finding: One Seat Belt Per Person: 14 children were observed exiting a vehicle where there were only 13 seats/seatbelts available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: One Seat Belt Per Person (26 TAC §746.5613)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Available in Each Building, on Field Trips, during Transportation: First aid kits on both vehicles used were observed to be missing tweezers    NOTE: Corrected at inspection, the tweezers were placed in each kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Available in Each Building, on Field Trips, during Transportation (26 TAC §746.4001)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: Upon arrival, a 7mo old infant was observed sleeping in a baby swing. The infant was then removed and placed in a crib.    NOTE: According to the caregiver, the infant had been sleep for approx. 3minutes prior to CCR arrival
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident: On one vehicle used 4 booster seats were observed to have expired between 2010-2021. Another vehicle used had 7 expired booster seates dated between 2010 and 2019.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): 2 caregivers hired after 9/1/2023 did not have a pre-empoyment affidavit on file
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Loose-fill surfacing was not observed to be properly maintained. Tarp under surfacing was exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: Hotdog buns with an expiration date of 2/26/25 were observed in the kitchen    NOTE: Corrected at inspection. The food was disposed of during the inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: An updated list of the children transported was on both vehicles was not available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): of the 10 staff files 4 staff did not a completed notarized affidavit on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Fire extinguisher was observed under the front passenger seat not secured. A fire extinguisher on another vehicle was observed unsecure next to the driver's seat
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: 6 caregiver who received education outside of the U.S. did not have documentation to verify high school education or equivalent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: Two infants were observed to be sleep in cribs with bibs on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: Observed bottles in the hand washing sink in the infant room during the inspection.    Note: The provider removed the bottles from the off the hand washing sink during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: Observed a nap mat layed out in the classroom for a child that was torn.    Note: The provider disposed the torn mat and provided the child with a new one during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child's hands were not washed after diapering during the inspection.     Note: The caregiver was corrected and had the child wash their hands after diapering and before they engaged in other activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Observed an unstable refrigerator in the infant room that poses a tipping hazard.    A slide in the outdoor play area has cracks in it located at the end of the slide.    A toilet seat in the girls restroom contains a loose screw in the back.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Observed an infant placed in a chair for use of safety straps and the straps were missing.     Note: The caregiver removed the chair and placed the child in another chair that was equipped with straps and secured the child in the chair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions: 1 child's file did not contain the completed information on limitations or restrictions.    Note: The provider corrected this at inspection by confirming with parent there were no limitations or restrictions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions (26 TAC §746.605(13)(A))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Name of Medication: The name of medication administered to a child was not documented on the medication log.    Note: The provider added the name of the medication during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Name of Medication (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: Buckets of mop water was observed in reach of children during the inspection.    Note: The provider moved the  mop water into locked closets out of reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The activity schedules in the Pre-Kindergarten classrooms did not show opportunities for outdoor time.     This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies did not contain the following information:    (A) The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play    (C) The type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at your operation   (D) Each setting in which your physical activity program will take place   (F) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: During the inspection children were resting on nap mats that contained another child's name ono it.     Note: This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The toilet seat in the Pre-Kinderarten classroom was cracked in the middle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: During the inspection multiple diaper changing mats were torn and cannot be cleaned properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23,2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
